cards.ex: I was just browsing around the bookstore, not really looking for anything specific.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki kitob do'konida aylanib yurdim, aniq bir narsa qidirganim yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Do'konlarda biror narsa sotib olishdan oldin shunchaki tomosha qilib yurmoq.

cards.ex: Consumer confidence is up this quarter, so retailers are expecting strong sales.
cards.exUz: Bu chorakda xaridorlarning ishonchi oshdi, shuning uchun sotuvchilar yaxshi savdo kutishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xaridorlarning iqtisodiy vaziyatga ishonchi va xarid qilishga tayyorligi.

cards.ex: They're living beyond their means, constantly buying things they can't afford.
cards.exUz: Ular imkoniyatlaridan tashqari yashashmoqda, doimo o'zlari to'lay olmaydigan narsalarni sotib olishadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z daromadidan ko'ra ko'proq pul sarflash.

cards.ex: It's tough to stick to a budget when you're surrounded by so many tempting things.
cards.exUz: Shuncha jozibali narsalar bilan o'ralganingizda byudjetga rioya qilish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Sarflash uchun belgilangan pul miqdoriga qat'iy amal qilish.

cards.ex: I added the dress to my cart, but I haven't decided if I'm going to buy it yet.
cards.exUz: Men ko'ylakni savatchamga qo'shdim, lekin uni sotib olamanmi yoki yo'qmi hali qaror qilmadim.
cards.uzDef: Onlayn do'konda sotib olmoqchi bo'lgan narsani savatchaga qo'shish.

cards.ex: We went to the mall and shopped till we dropped.
cards.exUz: Biz savdo markaziga bordik va charchaguncha xarid qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p xarid qilishdan charchaguncha xarid qilish.

cards.ex: Their products are aimed at a lower price point than their competitors.
cards.exUz: Ularning mahsulotlari raqobatchilarga qaraganda arzonroq narxga mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotning narxi qanchaligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: The company has several retail outlets across the country.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning butun mamlakat bo'ylab bir nechta chakana savdo joylari bor.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotlar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri iste'molchilarga sotiladigan joy.

cards.ex: The advertising campaign was designed to increase brand awareness.
cards.exUz: Reklama kampaniyasi brend xabardorligini oshirish uchun yaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Xaridorlar brendni qanchalik yaxshi bilishi va taniqli ekanligi.

cards.ex: Their target market is young adults aged 18 to 25.
cards.exUz: Ularning maqsadli bozori 18 yoshdan 25 yoshgacha bo'lgan yoshlar.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning mahsulotlarini sotishga mo'ljallangan aniq guruh.

cards.ex: The factory produces a wide range of consumer goods.
cards.exUz: Fabrika keng turdagi iste'mol mollarini ishlab chiqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar kundalik hayotda foydalanadigan mahsulotlar.

cards.ex: I'm going to shop around for a new laptop before I make a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishimdan oldin yangi noutbuk uchun qidirib yuraman.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi narxni topish uchun turli do'konlarda qidirmoq.

cards.ex: I'm not going to waste my hard-earned money on something I don't need.
cards.exUz: Men kerak bo'lmagan narsaga mashaqqatli topgan pulimni behuda sarflamayman.
cards.uzDef: Mehnat qilib topilgan pul.

cards.ex: They attract customers by offering competitive pricing.
cards.exUz: Ular raqobat narxlarini taklif qilish orqali xaridorlarni jalb qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatchilar bilan raqobatlasha oladigan narx siyosati.

cards.ex: The company has a large and loyal customer base.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning katta va sodiq xaridorlar bazasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning doimiy xaridorlari soni.

cards.ex: You can often find great deals in the bargain basement.
cards.exUz: Ko'pincha arzon joylarda ajoyib takliflarni topishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Do'konning eng arzon narsalar sotiladigan qismi.

cards.ex: That candy bar was an impulse purchase; I didn't need it.
cards.exUz: Bu konfet shoshilinch xarid edi; menga kerak emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan xarid.

cards.ex: The athlete signed an endorsement deal with a major sportswear company.
cards.exUz: Sportchi yirik sport kiyimlari kompaniyasi bilan reklama kelishuviga imzo chekdi.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur shaxsning mahsulotni reklama qilish uchun kelishuvi.

cards.ex: I got a really good deal on this TV; it was heavily discounted.
cards.exUz: Men bu televizorni juda yaxshi narxda oldim; u juda arzonlashtirilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Arzon narxda biror narsa sotib olmoq.

cards.ex: The company's sales figures were up 10% this year.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning savdo ko'rsatkichlari bu yil 10% ga oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning savdo hajmi va natijalari.

cards.ex: The restaurant's success is largely due to word of mouth.
cards.exUz: Restoranning muvaffaqiyati asosan og'zaki reklamaga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning bir-biriga mahsulot haqida gapirib berishi orqali reklama.

cards.ex: The retail industry is known for its cut-throat competition.
cards.exUz: Chakana savdo sanoati shafqatsiz raqobati bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va shafqatsiz raqobat.

cards.ex: The company is working hard to improve its brand image.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z brend imidjini yaxshilash ustida qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Brendning xaridorlar ongida yaratgan taassuroti.

cards.ex: Consumer spending is a key indicator of economic health.
cards.exUz: Xaridorlarning sarfi iqtisodiy salomatlikning asosiy ko'rsatkichidir.
cards.uzDef: Xaridorlarning tovarlar va xizmatlarga sarflagan puli.

cards.ex: Many small businesses went out of business during the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya davrida ko'plab kichik bizneslar bankrot bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z faoliyatini to'xtatish, bankrot bo'lish.

cards.ex: I think that 'limited edition' label is just a marketing ploy.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, 'cheklangan nashr' yorlig'i shunchaki marketing hiylasi.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotni sotish uchun ishlatiladigan marketing usuli.

cards.ex: We're going to the mall to shop 'til you drop!
cards.exUz: Biz charchaguncha xarid qilish uchun savdo markaziga boryapmiz!
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida xarid qilishdan charchash.

cards.ex: The sales representative gave us a detailed presentation of the product.
cards.exUz: Savdo vakili bizga mahsulot haqida batafsil taqdimot o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniya mahsulotlarini sotish bilan shug'ullanuvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: The company benefits from economies of scale due to its large production volume.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya katta ishlab chiqarish hajmi tufayli miqyos iqtisodiyotidan foyda ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Katta ishlab chiqarish hajmi tufayli xarajatlarning kamayishi.

cards.ex: Ethical consumerism is becoming increasingly popular.
cards.exUz: Axloqiy iste'mol tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy tamoyillarga asoslangan xarid qilish.
